comment: ClAMU (Kuo et al., 'Exact Unlearning of Finetuning Data via Model Merging at Scale', ICLR-2025 submission; papers/ClAMU.pdf) on the repo's canonical 1B. Full-FT, 200 per-author tasks (NO sign constraint), feature-clustered into K=16 groups, per-cluster masks optimized via STE. Sibling of the sift_masks arm; scored under the OU model_utility. Llama-3.2-1B has tied embeddings, so freezing embed_tokens also freezes the LM head.
